::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/gateway_accounts/{gwa}/webhook_endpoint"}
#docs
Idempotent unless `force` is passed — an already-configured account is returned unchanged (with the secret revealed) rather than re-provisioned. With `webhook_secret`, stores the gateway's secret instead (`secret_in` accounts).

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `gwa` | `string` | **yes** | The gateway account's id (gwa_…). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `force` | `boolean` | no | Re-provision / rotate even if already configured |
| `webhook_secret` | `string` | no | The signing secret you copied from the gateway's dashboard. Only for an account whose `mode` is `secret_in` (400 otherwise). It is kept with the account's other credentials and never returned; the response then has `configured: true`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `gateway_key` | `string` | The gateway that processed the payment. One of `tmtest`, `stripe`, `paypal`, `razorpay`, `gocardless`, `braintree`, `cashfree`, `adyen`, `checkoutcom`, `authorizenet`, `square`, `mollie`, `payu`, `cybersource`. |
| `notification_url` | `string` | The URL to register at the gateway for this account. |
| `secret` | `string` | Our generated secret to paste into the gateway. Only for `paste_required`, and only with `?reveal=true`. |
| `webhook_id` | `string` | The gateway webhook endpoint's webhook id. |
| `mode` | `string` | What the operator must do: nothing, we registered the endpoint (`self_provisioned`); paste our secret into the gateway (`paste_required`); paste the gateway's secret into this account as `webhook_secret` (`secret_in`); register the URL at the gateway, as signatures use the API credentials (`url_only`); or nothing, the gateway sends no webhooks (`not_applicable`). One of `self_provisioned`, `paste_required`, `secret_in`, `url_only`, `not_applicable`. |
| `configured` | `boolean` | We hold what we need to check signatures. For `url_only` this is always true; only the gateway knows whether the URL is registered. |
| `instructions` | `array of string` | The gateway webhook endpoint's instructions. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Webhook provisioning failed |
| `404` | No such gateway account |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/gateway_accounts/gwa_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/webhook_endpoint" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "force": false,
    "webhook_secret": "whsec_XXXXXXXXXXXX01"
  }'
```

```json [200 OK]
{
  "gateway_key": "tmtest",
  "notification_url": "https://example.com/webhooks/billing",
  "secret": "whsec_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
  "webhook_id": "Webhook id",
  "mode": "self_provisioned",
  "configured": false,
  "instructions": [
    "Instruction"
  ]
}
```
